source_mode: read-only local Codex JSONL session records
split: all accepted sessions assigned to the holdout block
candidate_unit: one completed prior Codex user/assistant turn
outcome_unit: anchors in a current-turn tool input whose call produced a matching output, plus anchors in a successful patch_apply_end record
label: a prior completed turn is relevant iff its normalized explicit anchors intersect the current turn's completed downstream tool-use anchors
export_time_encoding: trajectory-relative ordinal seconds from 2000-01-01T00:00:00Z; production timestamps are not exported
evaluation_scope: cold-start temporal holdout only; no design cases scored
